relation_p1: foster:killer was foster-father of the victim's wife (Hallgerður)
notes_p1: No blood or marriage tie. The link runs through Hallgerður.
evidence_p2: Síðan færði Þjóstólfur upp öxina í annað sinn og hjó í höfuð Þorvaldi og hafði hann þegar bana.
relation_detail_p2: Killer is foster-father of victim's wife Hallgerður (ch 9-10): affinal tie mediated by fosterage; no blood tie
note_p2: Þjóstólfur came with Hallgerður into Þorvaldur's household (ch 11). Coding choice affinity vs foster debatable.

relation_p1: foster:killer was foster-father of the victim's wife (Hallgerður)
evidence_p2: Þjóstólfur hjó þegar með öxinni í móti og kom á öxlina ... Glúmur mátti ekki halda því að dauðinn fór á hann.
relation_detail_p2: Killer is foster-father of victim's wife Hallgerður (ch 9, 13)
note_p2: Þjóstólfur lived in Glúmur's household at Varmalækur (ch 15-16).

relation_p1: foster:victim was foster-father of the killer's niece (Hallgerður)
notes_p1: Þjóstólfur is labelled a follower of Höskuldur's household (he was Hallgerður's fóstri), so this counts as within-group.
evidence_p2: Þá hjó Hrútur annað högg hann til bana og kom það í höfuðið.
relation_detail_p2: Victim was foster-father of the killer's niece Hallgerður (ch 9); no kin tie between them; Þjóstólfur's own family not given
note_p2: Þjóstólfur had been driven from Höskuldur's household (ch 15).

evidence_p2: Síðan vildi Ásvarður undan snúast. Hrappur höggur í sundur í honum hrygginn.
relation_detail_p2: Victim's family not given
note_p2: Killed in Norway. Hrappur was lodging in Guðbrandur's household, where Ásvarður was overseer; same household by residence.

relation_p1: affinity:distant (Lýtingur's wife Steinvör was sister of Ketill Sigfússon, who was married to the victim's half-sister Þorgerður)
notes_p1: Lýtingur's brothers Hallsteinn and Hallgrímur took part.
evidence_p2: Þeir spretta þá upp allir með vopnum og sækja að honum ... og féll síðan.
relation_detail_p2: No direct tie; remote affinal chain only (killer's wife's brother Ketill Sigfússon married victim's half-sister Þorgerður Njálsdóttir, ch 34, 98)
note_p2: Group ambush by Lýtingur, his two brothers and three house-carls; no individual death blow named, but Lýtingur is held liable and pays for víg Höskulds (ch 99).

notes_p1: The killer is collective ("margir"). Þangbrandur speared him and Guðleifur cut off his arm first.
evidence_p2: Þá leggur Þangbrandur sverði fyrir brjóst honum en Guðleifur hjó á höndina ... Gengu þá margir að og drápu berserkinn.
relation_detail_p2: Collective killer; no family for victim
note_p2: Victim is named Ótryggur. Þangbrandur and Guðleifur wounded him first.

notes_p1: Also an affinity link: Höskuldur's uncle Ketill was married to Skarphéðinn's sister.
evidence_p2: Hirð eigi þú að hopa á hæl, Hvítanesgoðinn" og höggur til hans og kom í höfuðið og féll Höskuldur á knéin.
relation_detail_p2: Foster-brothers: Höskuldur fostered by Njáll at Bergþórshvoll (ch 94); also affinity (Höskuldur's paternal uncle Ketill married Skarphéðinn's sister Þorgerður, ch 34)
note_p2: First blow; then 'Hljópu þeir þá að honum allir og unnu á honum'.

notes_p1: Grímur Njálsson.
evidence_p2: Hljópu þeir þá að honum allir og unnu á honum.
relation_detail_p2: Foster-brothers (Njáll fostered Höskuldur, ch 94); also affinity via Ketill Sigfússon x Þorgerður Njálsdóttir
note_p2: Skarphéðinn struck first; others joined in.

notes_p1: Helgi Njálsson.
evidence_p2: Hljópu þeir þá að honum allir og unnu á honum.
relation_detail_p2: Foster-brothers (ch 94); also affinity via Ketill Sigfússon x Þorgerður Njálsdóttir
note_p2: Skarphéðinn struck first; others joined in.

relation_p1: foster:wife's foster-brother (Höskuldur was foster-son of Kári's father-in-law Njáll)
evidence_p2: Hljópu þeir þá að honum allir og unnu á honum.
relation_detail_p2: No kin tie; Kári's wife Helga Njálsdóttir is the victim's foster-sister (ch 90, 94)
note_p2: Kári accompanied the brothers ('Þeir bræður fóru heim og Kári'). same_group yes = Njáll's household/foster-group; debatable.

notes_p1: Mörður Valgarðsson. He gave Höskuldur a wound that was not named when the wounds were witnessed (ch 121).
evidence_p2: Hljópu þeir þá að honum allir og unnu á honum.
relation_detail_p2: Second cousins: Mörður's mother Unnur was daughter of Mörður gígja Sighvatsson; Höskuldur's father Þráinn was son of Sigfús Sighvatsson (ch 1, 25, 34)
note_p2: Mörður instigated and was present; no individual blow.

relation_p1: foster:foster-brother (fóstbróðir; could also mean sworn brother)
notes_p1: Mentioned only in retrospect. Gaukur Trandilsson.
evidence_p2: Þar varð illa með þeim Ásgrími því að Ásgrímur varð banamaður Gauks.
relation_detail_p2: Sworn brothers (fóstbróðir Ásgríms), ch 26
note_p2: Narratorial aside; also referred to ch 139.

notes_p1: Different households but same paternal lineage. Þrándur instigated but did not take part in the attack (ch 7).
evidence_p2: Þrándur reikaði eftir fjörunni og skipverjar hans og voru eigi í aðsókn
relation_detail_p2: first cousins (Þrándur's father Þorbjörn and the brothers' father Sigmundur were brothers), ch 4
note_p2: Þrándur was in the attacking party and egged Hafgrímur on but did not fight; Brestir's death-wound came from Hafgrímur. Hákon jarl later fines Þrándur for the brothers' killing (ch 24). same_group yes = same lineage (Götuskeggjar kin).

notes_p1: As above; instigator, not active combatant.
evidence_p2: Nú sækja þeir að Beini í annan stað ... lauk svo að Beinir lét þar líf sitt
relation_detail_p2: first cousins (fathers were brothers), ch 4
note_p2: Þrándur held back; Beinir's killer not named (attackers led by Hafgrímur and Bjarni).

notes_p1: Bjarni is maternal uncle of Brestir's cousin Þrándur; no stated kinship with Brestir.
evidence_p2: veita þeir Hafgrímur og Svíneyjar-Bjarni þegar aðsókn að þeim bræðrum
relation_detail_p2: remote: Bjarni's sister Guðrún was wife of Brestir's paternal uncle Þorbjörn (ch 2, 4); no blood tie
note_p2: Bjarni led the assault but Hafgrímur gave Brestir the death-wound. Affinity is distant (uncle's wife's brother); could be coded none.

evidence_p2: lauk svo að Beinir lét þar líf sitt
relation_detail_p2: remote: Bjarni's sister was wife of Beinir's paternal uncle Þorbjörn (ch 2, 4)
note_p2: Bjarni was in the attack; who killed Beinir is not stated.

notes_p1: Master killed his own shepherd for riding Freyfaxi; employment, not kinship.
evidence_p2: þá hljóp hann af baki til hans og hjó hann banahögg.
relation_detail_p2: Victim was the killer's hired shepherd (servant); no kin tie
note_p2: Killed for riding Freyfaxi; same household as employee

relation_p1: affinity:distant (victim's first cousin Þorvaldur Þorgilsson was marrying killer's paternal aunt Sigríður)
notes_p1: Killed during the wedding feast at Klakka-Ormur's after Glæðir's insults.
evidence_p2: gekk Þorkell eftir honum og hjó til hans í höfuðið og hafði Glæðir þegar bana
relation_detail_p2: no tie stated
note_p2: Killing at the wedding feast at Klakka-Ormur's (Forsæludalur) after Glæðir mocked Þorkell as 'ambáttarson'.

relation_p1: blood:maternal uncle (victim was killer's mother's brother); also foster:foster-father
notes_p1: Kin-killing. Revenge for Brodd-Helgi, whom Geitir had killed (ch 13). Bjarni regretted it at once, and Geitir died in his lap.
evidence_p2: Bjarni hjó þá í höfuð Geiti og fékk hann þegar bana.
relation_detail_p2: maternal uncle (Geitir's sister Halla was Bjarni's mother), ch 3; also foster-father (Bjarni 'að fóstri í Krossavík með Geiti'), ch 3
note_p2: Bjarni immediately regrets it; Geitir dies in his lap. Geitir had led the killing of Bjarni's father Brodd-Helgi (ch 13).

notes_p1: Helgi killed the slave straight after Hallsteinn's death. Nearby sentence_ids 306 and 307 label this pair the other way round in places.
evidence_p2: sá að Hallsteinn var veginn. Helgi drap þegar þrælinn.
relation_detail_p2: victim was slave of killer's stepfather
note_p2: Helgi was wintering in his stepfather's household where Þorgils was a slave; same_group judged by household.

notes_p1: Revenge for his brother Helgi Droplaugarson (killed ch 10).
evidence_p2: En síðan lagði Grímur sverðinu á Helga svo að stóð í gegnum hann.
relation_detail_p2: distant: Helgi Á.'s first wife Droplaug was daughter of Bessi Hávarsson (Bessastaðir, mother Ingibjörg), brother of Grímur's grandmother Yngveldur Hávarsdóttir (ch 2-3)
note_p2: Affinity tie inferred from genealogy (first wife = Grímur's father's first cousin); text never calls them mágar. Revenge for Helgi Droplaugarson.

notes_p1: Grímur was an outlaw paid to kill Grettir. sentence_id 2850 is ch 51 and has nothing to do with this killing.
evidence_p2: Hafði hann af honum þá sannar sögur og drap hann síðan.
relation_detail_p2: victim's family not given; no tie
note_p2: Grímur lived with Grettir in his hut as companion; same_group by shared household. Homonyms: other Grímur (Þórhallsson, Gamli's brother; Grímur of Kroppur ch 62) are not the victim.

notes_p1: Halldór (12) hamstrung Vali. His only link to Vali is indirect: Vali was the brother of his foster-father Bersi's wife.
evidence_p2: Halldór komst á bak Vala og beitir á hásinar honum Hvítingi. ... Þá setti Bersi spjótið milli herðanna. Var það hans banasár.
relation_detail_p2: indirect: victim was brother-in-law of Halldór's foster-father Bersi (ch 14-15)
note_p2: Halldór hamstrung Váli; Bersi gave the death wound. Both declared the killing.

relation_p1: affinity:brother of his sister's betrothed (Ásbjörn, later her husband)
notes_p1: Ormur had threatened to seduce Sigríður, who was betrothed to his brother Ásbjörn.
evidence_p2: Þá hjó Þórður höfuð af Ormi og gekk síðan heim til Óss og lýsti vígi Orms á hönd sér.
relation_detail_p2: No tie at time of killing; victim was a cousin of Eiður Skeggjason (Þórður's 'fóstri'), and his brother Ásbjörn later married Þórður's sister Sigríður (ch 12-13)
note_p2: Ormur had sought Sigríður in marriage. Coded none because the affinity arises only later and the foster link is indirect

relation_p1: affinity:first cousin of his sister's betrothed (distant)
notes_p1: Össur was avenging his cousin Ormur. The tie is distant and could be coded 'none'.
evidence_p2: Í því hjó Þórður til Össurar og kom það högg undir hina vinstri höndina ... Féll hann þegar dauður niður.
relation_detail_p2: No direct tie; victim was a first cousin of Eiður Skeggjason, Þórður's 'fóstri'
note_p2: Earlier fight in ch 8 left Össur wounded; killed in second ambush ch 9

evidence_p2: bregður Þormóður höggöxi undan skikkju sinni og höggur í höfuð Loðini svo að hann féll þegar dauður
relation_detail_p2: slave, no family given
note_p2: Þormóður was wintering (til vistar) in Brattahlíð, so killer and victim were in the same household at the time; same_group is debatable since Þormóður was a lodger, not kin. Rivalry over the woman Sigríður.

relation_p1: sworn (?): called 'fóstbræður' while trading partners abroad
notes_p1: They were trading partners (félag) and ch 4 calls them 'fóstbræður'; no blood or marriage tie at the time. Einar had married Þorsteinn's betrothed Helga.
evidence_p2: Síðan lagði Þorsteinn að Einari með spjótinu og í gegnum hann. Einar féll dauður inn í skemmuna.
relation_detail_p2: No tie; former trading partners (ch 3); Einar had married Þorsteinn's intended bride Helga by falsely reporting his death
note_p2: Homonym: Einar Þorfinnsson is the killer's brother
